responsibility: Declares the lightweight public interface for diagnostics color handling. It defines the diagnostic_color_rule_t policy enum used by option processing and exposes the runtime entry points to initialize colorization and retrieve start/stop escape sequences for named diagnostic styling categories, serving as the sink-facing API over the environment parsing and terminal detection logic implemented in color.cc.
same_name_distinction: This header is the declaration side of the color pair: it defines the diagnostic_color_rule_t policy enum and declares colorize_start, colorize_stop, and colorize_init for use by printers and sinks. Unlike color.cc, it does not contain the style dictionary, environment parsing, terminal detection, or URL-policy logic.
